title: Second moment under sign reversal
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $a_0$ be real, and let $a$ assign a real coefficient to each of the $n$ coordinates. The uniform expectation of $(-a_0+L(x))^2$ equals that of $(a_0+L(x))^2$, where $L(x)$ is the linear form with coefficients $a$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is a real-valued function on the $n$ coordinates
